decision.explanation: The question asks when the construction of the Time-Life Building started. Document D1S2 explicitly states that 'Construction on the Time-Life Building's steelwork started in April 1958.' This directly supports the answer 'April 1958.' The other candidate, 'June 1936' (from D2S2), refers to excavation for a different building at 1 Rockefeller Plaza, which was later renamed and became part of the Time & Life complex, but it does not pertain to the actual construction start of the Time-Life Building itself. Therefore, 'June 1936' is contextually irrelevant to the specific question asked.
